title: Partition overlapping notes into the fewest audio tracks inside a group (lanes.rs)
description:
## Intent

Overlapping notes on one track go to extra audio tracks inside a group track.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/lanes.rs`: partition a track's events into the fewest non-overlapping sequences (sort by start, greedy first-free; deterministic tie-break by event order). One sequence → a plain audio track; more → a group track named after the track holding audio tracks `<name> 1`, `<name> 2`, …
- The group takes the track's place: its position in the track list and its own group membership (`TrackInfo.out`). Record in `design/daw-set.md` that from M3 on the track's effects, volume, pan and sends go on this group, and its lanes stay flat.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw` — unit tests for the partition (chords, `at` notes, humanize overlaps, none) and the "Notes that overlap on one track" scenarios pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): overlapping notes on extra audio tracks in a group`. Not breaking.
